title: One change adds a mail password to the settings file and builds a database query from raw text in another file
diff:
diff --git a/app/config.py b/app/config.py
--- a/app/config.py
+++ b/app/config.py
@@ -2,3 +2,4 @@
 
 DATABASE_URL = os.environ["DATABASE_URL"]
 SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com"
+SMTP_PASSWORD = "Tr0ub4dor-prod-mailer-2026"
diff --git a/app/db/exports.py b/app/db/exports.py
--- a/app/db/exports.py
+++ b/app/db/exports.py
@@ -4,3 +4,9 @@
 def export_all():
     conn = get_connection()
     return conn.execute("SELECT id, email FROM users").fetchall()
+
+
+def export_by_domain(domain: str):
+    conn = get_connection()
+    sql = "SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%%@%s'" % domain
+    return conn.execute(sql).fetchall()
